sensor_preprocessing.I;16*: divide by 65535 before resize, preserving original integer mode
sensor_preprocessing.I/F: divide by max(finite original-image maximum, 1) before resize
sensor_preprocessing.thermal_color: preserve RGB color (including palette/RGBA conversion), divide by 255; not calibrated temperature
sensor_preprocessing.thermal_scalar: normalize in original scalar mode and repeat to 3 channels for batching
sensor_preprocessing.depth_other: convert L and divide by 255; retain a single depth channel
sensor_preprocessing.validity: pixel valid iff every normalized channel finite in [0,1]; zero depth invalid; zero thermal valid
sensor_preprocessing.resize: bilinear valid-weighted value and coverage; align_corners=False
sensor_preprocessing.supervision_coverage: input pixel valid iff coverage >= 0.99; feature-area coverage >= 0.99
sensor_preprocessing.teacher_invalid_input: zero fill; no NaN/Inf enters teacher
